title: Affine model data for component extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of the component extension theorem and a local pointed etale triple t, there exist a global pointed etale triple c and a map i : c.B → t.B satisfying the structure and pointing compatibility equations.

proof.text: Apply etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_component_extension_compatible with the given R, p, K, χ, q, ψ, hψ, hK, and t. It constructs the identity triple over R with the composite R → R_p → t.B, proving both compatibility equations simultaneously. No assertion about arbitrary models or arbitrary structure-preserving maps is needed.
